subject: HSPACE status: retargeting solid, multi-person placement needs a QA gate
body:
Lucia, Alina,

Status ahead of the May render campaign. GHUM fitting QA is done on all 100 base scans; the parametric variation sweep produced the full 1,600-human set and dressed-human retargeting holds up well - under 3% of motion clips show visible skinning artifacts, and Milan's engine export runs clean.

The risk is jointly consistent multi-person scene placement. In our current outdoor scenes about 11% of sampled multi-person configurations have interpenetration or implausible contact when two moving people cross paths. That's high enough to contaminate training signal for occlusion-heavy benchmarks - which is exactly the regime this dataset is supposed to be strongest in. Proposal: add an automated collision/contact QA gate before a frame enters v1, at an estimated cost of ~8% render throughput.

If we accept the throughput hit we still make the June 8 freeze, but with maybe 0.9M frames instead of 1.1M. Want a decision this week so Farah can bake the gate into the orchestration.

Freya
